findings.scope: ssok issue32 foreground app-goal operator: agent_goal_inbox.gd, agent_desktop_bridge.gd, agent_camera_loop.gd, run_operator.py, run_goal.py, desktop_session.py, desktop_mcp.py, desktop_client.py, plus the _on_agent_goal_requested excerpt

prior_findings.B1_old_goal_context_lost_before_first_ob: resolved. Inbox binds episode_id/control_generation/revision at submit; poll re-checks _context_valid before claiming; run_operator re-describes before dispatch; run_goal validates --expected-context and asserts it against describe before CLI start; DesktopGoalSession.observe asserts self.context against describe AND against the returned frame metadata; run_goal's monitor loop exits on any running-context change.
prior_findings.B2_stopped_fault_cancellation_depends_on: resolved. AgentGoalInbox._on_loop_state cancels whenever busy and loop.state is stopped/fault, independent of context; AgentCameraLoop.cancel always increments control_generation, disables, brakes, and emits state_changed before operation_finished.

nonblocking.detail: If the user re-enables the camera (new begin) while an operator goal is running, the inbox correctly clears, run_goal sees context_changed and exits, but its finally-block Stop then cancels the user's brand-new session. Safety-conservative, not a control hazard; consider skipping the final Stop when the observed episode_id/generation no longer matches expected_context and state is already not 'ready' for that context.

nonblocking.area: Decision timeout vs. operator startup latency
nonblocking.file: src/runtime/agent_camera_loop.gd (DECISION_TIMEOUT_MS 60000 armed at first capture); tools/app_control/run_operator.py
nonblocking.detail: The job is claimed only when state=='ready', which starts a 60 s decision deadline. Codex login check (up to 15 s) plus CLI startup must deliver the first observe inside that window or the loop faults (decision_timeout), the inbox cancels, and run_goal exits 1 as context_changed. Observed runs passed, but this is a latent reliability limit; no security impact.

While run_operator waits on its child it does not heartbeat; ownership is held only via _claimed. After the job ends, heartbeat is stale, so a second operator process can become _operator before the first's operator_leave, which then fails invalid_operator (caught). Harmless because claimed jobs reject other identities, but a short explicit post-job grace or re-poll would make the UI status cleaner.

Any holder of SSOK_AGENT_TOKEN on loopback (e.g. a manually launched run_goal) can still drive the same episode alongside the operator's session. Frames are single-consume and DesktopGoalSession rejects reused frames, so no double-dispatch of one frame, but two sessions could alternate. Pre-existing token model; document as a known limit.

Loop _exit_tree disables without emitting state_changed; a pending inbox request then lingers until QUEUE/GOAL TTL. Bridge _exit_tree does call loop.cancel on normal shutdown, so only a detached-loop edge case; cheap fix is to also cancel the inbox from the app's teardown path.

nonblocking.area: Status wording on invalid context at claim
nonblocking.detail: cancel() with default status reports 'Goal run stopped.' when the claim was refused because the context went stale; 'failed' wording would match _on_loop_state. Cosmetic.

nonblocking.area: Goal text visible to local process list
nonblocking.detail: Goal and public context are passed as child argv. Token is not. Local-only exposure of user-typed goal text; acceptable, note in docs.

verified_properties.stop_cancellation: Human Stop and bridge stop lane both reach loop.cancel('local_stop'); inbox clears on stopped/fault; run_goal detects operator_or_app_stopped vs actor_stopped via events and always issues a final Stop; run_operator stops the app before terminating the runner on error/timeout.
verified_properties.exclusive_controller_ownership: begin disables runtime/manual/motion program; _context_valid rejects manual re-enable, runtime running, revision or body change; poll rejects a second operator while one is connected or has a claimed job; leave only by the owning identity.
verified_properties.stale_goal_frame: Submit-time triple bound end-to-end; first describe and first frame both asserted; drive_step requires exact episode/frame/revision/generation and unconsumed frame; decide re-asserts with include_frame.
verified_properties.operator_capability_separation: operator_poll/operator_leave only via DesktopClient(allow_operator=True) in run_operator; run_goal/desktop_mcp clients default allow_operator=False; Codex is restricted to observe/decide/stop by enabled_tools with shell/code/web/apps/multi_agent disabled and read-only sandbox.
verified_properties.no_login_api_fallback: forced_login_method=chatgpt, requires_openai_auth=true, OPENAI_API_KEY popped from env, login status checked in both operator and runner, request/stream retries 0.
verified_properties.bounded_one_job: run_operator exits after one claimed job; 8 steps/9 observations/300 s policy asserted before dispatch; inbox QUEUE_TTL 20 s, GOAL_LIMIT 310 s; runner wait 345 s; session call cap 2*observations+steps.
verified_properties.secrets_output: Goal rejected if it contains the token or control chars; client rejects token in args/responses; CLI diagnostics redact token and UUIDs; manifest/result/events contain only public fields; stdout limited to JSON manifest/result.
